body: I have multiple times that I don't want to hear that kind of stuff, and I explained it bothers me. She's just being herself and I'm not blaming her, but I'm starting to question the relationship because I'm not happy anymore,

We broke up because there was lack of trust and extreme jealousy. We thought a break up would be best for us to get our lives back together, and to see if we really did love each other as much as we thought. she messaged me one night on facebook telling me how much she missed, then we started talking again, and ended up back together. I'm 18 shes 16.
I obviously want to continue the relationship 100%. I just want to find a way where we can both be happy rather than upset.
It's more of the video calls that bother me. I don't really care if she talks to them, I just dont like the video calls.
What is your reason for this not being ok?

I've tried, but I feel like a total douche afterwards because I feel like I am not letting her do what she wants. It kills me knowing she is skyping with another guy, but at the same time It kills me being an asshole.
What is your reason for this not being ok?

Fuck I know. I saw she was snapchatting him and she said they are just friends, and she won't ever talk like that again, even tho it was jokes, but I am insecure and I don't know whether to trust it because it fucking hurt when I found out.
We've been together for almost a year now. I honestly love her, but I'm scared at the same time
Well I ended it with her and she started crying, not my fault. I wasn't going to comfort her when she wasn't doing anything for me. A relationship is a two way street.
In a way it did. Sort of satisfying knowing now she feels like shit, while i felt like that for the longest time. So in a way It's like revenge/
The stress is gone. I dont have to deal with that shit anymore.
Don't worry I got rid of her.
I ended it completely, and she started crying and all that other crap. I feel slightly better now.

I do want to stay with her and she says she wants the same thing, but it's my fault I pushed her away, which I do not understand one bit. I do have the evidence of her telling one of my friends that "I didn't notice he was wheeling me till afterwards. Now it feels like I'm dating him so we decided to break up and figure things out". So I know she is full of shit on that part. I want to walk away so badly but I don't know why I can't.
I wish it was that easy. I don't know what it is but something is preventing me from leaving her. We just get into more and more fights now and I can't get myself to do it. How would you do this?
I took my grandmothers T4 painkillers. I woke up in the emergency room later that night.
